title: תרגיל הדגמה — מגע ראשון

window.place: The southern edge of Yokneam Illit on Ramat Menashe (יקנעם עילית, רמת מנשה): the town's houses on the hill in the south-east, Route 6 (כביש 6) in the west, low ground to the north.

about: A small hotseat demonstration: a BLUE infantry platoon in the low ground to
the north attacking a RED position on the town's edge to the south, held by
two squads and a tank. The hill's shoulder hides the slope below it from
every RED position, so BLUE's first bound is unseen and it comes into view
as it reaches the shoulder — to the forward squad, the flank squad on the
north-east ridge and the tank alike.
One lesson the ground teaches on its own: the tank's hatches see over the
shoulder to the far low ground where BLUE starts, 440 m off, and not the
slope just below it where the attack actually climbs — dead ground is
nearer than it looks.
The player is the platoon leader: they manoeuvre the squads and control
their own command group. Played with the knowledge model on, so each side
sees what it has detected — the document's own rolls — rather than
everything within a radius.
RED's forward squad lies on the shoulder in the open and prepared its
position before the battle, so it starts fully camouflaged (rules decision
12): BLUE will not find it by looking. It is also the one force here that
lays charges during the battle (rules decision 16) — the rule gives that
work to an insurgent or special force, and until force types arrive with
echelon scaling the scenario is what says which force is one.
⚠️ That last part is ours, not the author's: the demo's RED is a
conventional platoon, and the flag is here so the rule can be played
rather than only tested. One line to delete when force types land.

forces.name: מחלקה א'/2
forces.note: The second squad holds the ridge coming down from the north-east, on the flank of the axis.

forces.name: טנק
forces.note: In a street on the hilltop behind the crest. It stands 4.6 m from the nearest house — outside the 3 m cover reach on purpose, since full cover would drop its eye to 0.5 m and switch the far-low-ground lesson off (src/app/scenario.test.ts pins it).

forces.name: חפ"ק מ"מ
forces.note: In one of the houses on the reverse slope: it sees none of the shoulder.
